basis: Native Lion's Mane Jelly is Cyanea, not Aequorea or Pelagia. No accepted positive Cyanea match was located in the retrieved species dataset; this is not proof of biological absence.
remaining_evidence: Accepted positive species-level observation, tissue map and trigger for the native jelly.

basis: The native green moray has reported biofluorescence; the characterized protein is from G. zonipectis. Fluorescence under excitation does not justify an autonomous night lamp.
remaining_evidence: RGB material strength and colour are graphical approximations; exact native-species optical measurements remain unavailable.
